verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships a native CI/CD system (Pipelines) that runs headlessly with hosted or private runners and 'no infrastructure needed,' and explicitly supports triggering AI-powered automated workflows (cleanup, docs, release notes, flaky-test fixes) from the pipeline. This directly satisfies running the product headlessly/in CI for automation.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Pipelines reliability and any CLI-level headless invocation outside the pipeline UI.
